title: Google Play Scraper
description: Scrape Google Play apps (search, category, home, developer, detail, data safety). Free Apify plan users: up to 10 runs of this Actor and up to 200 results per run. These limits are set by the Actor developer (not Apify). Upgrade to a paid Apify plan for unlimited runs. Package ids must come from live Play links — this Actor does not invent them.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Play surface. search/category/home/developer use first-pack HTML. detail/datasafety need live packageIds.

q.title: Search query
q.description: Play search q. Used when mode=search. Empty {} uses this default so platform auto-test SUCCEEDED.

category.title: Category CODE
category.description: Play category such as GAME, SPORTS, TRAVEL_AND_LOCAL. Required for mode=category.

developerId.title: Developer id
developerId.description: Numeric /store/apps/dev?id= value from a live detail page.

packageIds.title: Package ids
packageIds.description: Live Play package names from a previous search (do not invent). Used for detail/datasafety.

c.title: Search catalog
c.description: Play search c=. Only apps is opened (c=games returned 404 this session).

market.title: Market preset
market.description: us = hl=en gl=US (opened). ph = hl=zh-CN gl=PH (opened). Other presets are 未验证.

hl.title: Language (hl)
hl.description: Play hl BCP-47. Overrides market preset when set.

gl.title: Country (gl)
gl.description: Play gl ISO country. Overrides market preset. Unopened countries are accepted with a warning.

maxResults.title: Max results (max 1,000; free users capped at 200/run)
maxResults.description: Maximum results this run (1–1,000). Free Apify plan users: also limited to 10 total runs of this Actor (Actor developer policy).

enrichDetails.title: Enrich list rows with detail JSON-LD

includeDataSafety.title: Include data-safety summary
includeDataSafety.description: Fetches /store/apps/datasafety for each detail row (partial field tree).

includeReviews.title: Include reviews overlay (not collected)
includeReviews.description: Review bodies are not scraped. Enabling only adds a warning (no batchexecute forge).

workerBaseUrl.title: Worker base URL (optional)
workerBaseUrl.description: Override worker origin for this run. Default: Actor env WORKER_BASE_URL. Must be https:// and allowlisted (*.run.app or localhost).
